title: Compatibility renderer (and thus project manager) crashes on startup when running from macOS virtual machine
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.6-stable, 4.5.1-stable, 4.4.1-stable, 4.3-stable, 4.2.2-stable, 4.1.4-stable, 4.0.3-stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - macOS Tahoe (26.2.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple Paravirtual device (Apple5) - Apple M2 Pro (Virtual) (6 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

When trying to run any 4.x version of Godot through a [UTM](https://mac.getutm.app/) (QEMU) virtual machine on macOS, you end up with the following crash:

Running with `--rendering-method forward_plus` or `--rendering-method mobile` fixes the problem and seems to run just fine.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Set up a macOS virtual machine using [UTM](https://mac.getutm.app/).
2. Run Godot (i.e. open the project manager) in 4.6-stable.
3. Note the crash.
